subject: Finance window overlap — demo coordination and new timing
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.biz>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evergreen.biz
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request to schedule a technical demo next week

Hi Irene and Ben,

Thanks for the quick discovery last week — the team and I discussed Redwood internally and we'd like to see a concise walk-through focused on inference economics and on-prem controls.

Can you do a 45-minute demo next Wednesday or Thursday (Jul 18–19) morning PT? Two constraints on our side: the CTO is traveling early next week and procurement wants a short SOW before scheduling any long technical sessions.

If it helps, procurement@evergreen.biz is CC'd here. We're aiming to lock a window before our finance committee meets on Jul 26.

Cheers,
Marta Lopez
Head of IT Procurement
Evergreen Health Systems

Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.biz>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, procurement@evergreen.biz
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule a technical demo next week

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and for looping procurement in. We can absolutely do a focused 45-minute demo. Quick reality check: the CFO and a few finance leads at Evergreen are in a travel block between Jul 16–24 and Finance has signaled they may pause new pilot commitments until the FY budget reset the week of Aug 6.

Given that, I want to avoid wasting your execs' time. Two options:
- Keep a short, non-technical 30-min briefing next week (Jul 18) to align on use cases, procurement asks, and next steps — we can circulate a one-pager + SOW stub ahead of time.
- Or move the full technical walkthrough to the week of Aug 6 when the finance gate reopens and key approvers are available.

If you prefer the former, I can send calendar invites for Jul 18 morning PT and include a short pre-read. If the team is gating on procurement sign-off, moving to Aug makes sense.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 10, 2028 at 09:18 AM Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.biz> wrote:
> Hi Irene and Ben,
> 
> Thanks for the quick discovery last week — the team and I discussed Redwood internally...
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Evergreen — recommend holding demo until post-FY reset (prep items)

Marissa / Karthik — looping you both in to coordinate.

Context: Ben flagged that Evergreen's finance and CTO travel windows overlap with our proposed demo dates. Procurement is engaged and asked for a SOW before longer technical sessions. The customer explicitly said the finance committee meets Jul 26 and there is an internal spend-gate until the FY reset week of Aug 6.

Recommendation: push the full technical walkthrough to the week of Aug 6. In the meantime, offer a 20–30 minute briefing for stakeholders who want a high-level view (no deep Q&A) during the Jul 18 slot. That keeps momentum but protects our SE bandwidth.

Prep asks (short):
- Marissa: can you draft a 1-page procurement one-pager tailored to Evergreen (procurement asks, data retention, KMS options, audit logs). Attach as PDF.
- Ben: prepare a SOW stub (two-page) that procurement can review; mark placeholders for billing cadence and PO terms.
- Karthik: if we think a small pilot discount or temporary extended trial will help cross the finance gate, propose numbers we can escalate.

I'll send the Jul 18 hold for the briefing and the proposed Aug 7–9 windows for the full demo; we can finalize after procurement reviews the SOW. Please share drafts by COB Jul 14 so I can include them with the briefing invite.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Strategist, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-onepager-for-procurement.pdf
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.biz>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evergreen.biz
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finance window overlap — demo coordination and new timing

Irene / Ben — thanks for the clear options and for being flexible. Procurement reviewed the SOW stub Ben shared (thanks) and asked that we move the full technical walkthrough until after our finance committee completes the FY reset. Jul 18 briefing works for our director-level stakeholders; please keep it tight to 25–30 minutes.

Proposed full-demo windows: Aug 7 or Aug 8 morning PT (we prefer Aug 7). Can you hold Aug 7 at 10:00 AM PT as a tentative slot? I'll confirm after the committee meets on Jul 26.

Irene — attaching a short procurement checklist we use internally so your one-pager can line up with it.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of IT Procurement
Evergreen Health Systems

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf
